Title: Makes provisions permanent related to inspections of private passenger automobiles prior to the provision of coverage for physical damage thereto
Summary: Removes the sunset date of October 1, 2027; makes provisions permanent related to inspections of private passenger automobiles prior to the provision of coverage for physical damage thereto.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend chapter 638 of the laws of 2023 amending the insurance law relating to inspections of private passenger automobiles prior to the provision of coverage for physical damage thereto, in relation to making such provisions permanent
